maria: APAC standby credit fell to 0 — livestream at 22:00 SGT. Can procurement/topup vendor confirm temporary top-up (8 slots) or a short borrow from EU? Pls advise. ENGINFRA-842

devon: pinging vendor_ops and finance. PR created to request quota bump: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1234

devon: quick terraform snippet I pushed to that PR:
```
resource "vendor_quota_request" "apac_standby" {
  region = "apac-southeast1"
  gpu = "a100"
  count = 8
  reason = "livestream 22:00 SGT"
}
```

ashley: vendor acked - they can do 8 standby slots but ETA ~3.5h (need billing clearance). I have them holding. Finance oncall @raj — can you clear temporary charge? :pray:

raj: oncall finance — I can clear up to $5k for emergency. Approving ENGINFRA-842, will do CC auth now.

ashley: vendor confirmed charge auth received. They'll inject slots and provide tenant IDs. ETA ~2h now. :thumbsup:

maria: awesome — if they drop in, can someone run a quick smoke: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://inference.redwood/api/v1/status` look for pool=apac-standby healthy

devon: will do. tagging oncallops to watch the canary.

sre-bot: Deploy hook: standby pool update scheduled via terraform apply (PR merged). Runbook ENGINFRA-842 updated: https://wiki.redwood/infrastructure/ENGINFRA-842

ashley: vendor sent tenant IDs: t-1123,t-1124. devon pls add to pool labels.

devon: added labels and kicked smoke. Results: `200 OK` pool=apac-standby healthy, 8 GPUs visible. Leaving monitoring on alert channel. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks team. leaving this thread open until post-livestream de-provision. :rocket:
